definitions.explanation: The practice of examining one's own thoughts, feelings, and motivations. Used broadly in psychology and everyday reflection, and specifically as the name of a structured therapeutic method developed in Japan.

examples.japanese: {内観|ないかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}める→深める：02407_fukameru⟧。

⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{内観|ないかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Every night before bed, I set aside time for quiet self-reflection.

examples.japanese: {内観|ないかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づくこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Through introspection, I was able to notice the causes of my own behavior.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ (inside, inner) and {観|かん} (viewing, observation). Refers to turning one's attention inward to examine one's own mental state, motivations, and past actions.

In addition to its general meaning, {内観|ないかん} is also the name of a specific Japanese psychotherapeutic method ({内観|ないかん}⟦{療法|りょうほう}→療法：13615_ryouhou⟧) developed by Yoshimoto Ishin in the 1940s. In this structured practice, participants reflect on their relationships by asking three questions: what they received from others, what they gave in return, and what trouble they caused.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内観|ないかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to introspect, to look inward
- {内観|ないかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}める→深める：02407_fukameru⟧: to deepen one's self-reflection
- {内観|ないかん}⟦{療法|りょうほう}→療法：13615_ryouhou⟧: naikan therapy
- {内観|ないかん}⟦{瞑想|めいそう}→瞑想：13660_meisou⟧: introspective meditation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反省|はんせい}→反省：03570_hansei⟧: reflection — focuses on evaluating past actions, often with a sense of regret or self-criticism
- ⟦{自省|じせい}→自省：20401_jisei⟧: self-examination — formal synonym closer in meaning, but less associated with meditation or therapy
- {内省|ないせい}: introspection — near-synonym used more in academic and philosophical contexts
- ⟦{瞑想|めいそう}→瞑想：13660_meisou⟧: meditation — broader practice that may or may not involve self-examination
